Dear Nordlicht Computing GmbH accounts receivable team,

We have matched your invoice INV-2026-104 (issued 2026-09-27, total EUR 2,275.00) against our purchase order PO-2026-104 and goods receipt GRN-2026-104 (your delivery note DN-2026-104). We cannot release payment because the unit price does not agree with the contract.

- Unit price: invoiced EUR 455.00 against PO price EUR 410.00, i.e. +EUR 45.00 per unit (+10.98%). Our tolerance is 1% (maximum EUR 414.10).

What we expect: either (a) a corrected invoice for EUR 2,050.00 with the unit price at EUR 410.00, with INV-2026-104 cancelled, or (b) a credit note for EUR 225.00 referencing INV-2026-104. If you believe a different price was agreed, please send the supporting quotation or contract amendment. Payment of the invoice (due 2026-10-27) is on hold until this is resolved; nothing is payable on the current invoice.

Please reply quoting PO-2026-104 and INV-2026-104.

Kind regards,
Accounts Payable

Dear Atlantic Office Supplies Ltd accounts team,

We have matched your invoice INV-2026-105 (issued 2026-09-27, total EUR 6,200.00) against our purchase order PO-2026-105, your delivery note DN-2026-105 (DHL Freight, tracking DHL1050042IE) and our goods receipt GRN-2026-2026105. The invoice does not agree and we cannot approve it for payment.

Line 1, AO-DESK Sit-stand desk 160 cm:
- Ordered (PO-2026-105): 10 at EUR 620.00
- Shipped per your delivery note DN-2026-105: 8
- Received in good condition (GRN-2026-2026105): 8
- Invoiced: 10 at EUR 620.00 = EUR 6,200.00

The unit price matches the PO. The quantity does not: 2 desks are billed but were not delivered, an over-billing of 2 x EUR 620.00 = EUR 1,240.00. The amount we can reconcile is 8 x EUR 620.00 = EUR 4,960.00.

What we expect, either of:
1. A credit note for EUR 1,240.00 against INV-2026-105, or a corrected invoice for 8 units totalling EUR 4,960.00 (and cancellation of INV-2026-105), if the remaining 2 desks will not be supplied; or
2. Delivery of the missing 2 desks against PO-2026-105 with a delivery note, after which we will receive them and match the invoice as billed.

Please reply with which option you will take and the expected date. No payment will be released on INV-2026-105 (due 2026-10-27) until this is resolved.

Kind regards,
Accounts Payable
